connector.name: Finance MCP
connector.registryDescription: Live stock, crypto, SEC filings, FX and macro data for LLM agents. No API keys.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package finance-data-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the adityasbisht account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.name: SEC_USER_AGENT
env.description: Contact string sent to SEC EDGAR on every request, in the form "Your Name your@email.com". EDGAR returns HTTP 403 without it, so the three SEC tools need this set; all other tools work without it.
